concepts.LX-CORE-NODE: Class-based node graph, stable node keys, parent/sibling links, and latest/writable versions
concepts.LX-CORE-NODE-CONFIG: Static node configuration, registration, replacement, inheritance, and DOM/JSON codecs
concepts.LX-CORE-STATE: Immutable EditorState snapshots and mutable pending double buffer
concepts.LX-CORE-UPDATE: Synchronous ambient read/update context, nested update queue, commit, rollback, and tags
concepts.LX-CORE-DIRTY: Dirty leaf/element tracking, transform fixed point, and normalization
concepts.LX-CORE-RECONCILE: Incremental imperative DOM reconciliation and mutation accounting
concepts.LX-CORE-SELECTION: Point, range, node selection, editing transforms, and DOM selection mapping
concepts.LX-CORE-CARET: Typed directional tree caret and range traversal
concepts.LX-CORE-COMMAND: Typed command tokens, listener priority, propagation, and editor dispatch
concepts.LX-CORE-EVENT: Contenteditable event transport, browser branching, composition, clipboard, and input
concepts.LX-CORE-LISTENER: Editor update, mutation, root, editable, text, and decorator listeners
concepts.LX-CORE-NODE-STATE: Descriptor-backed per-node state, lazy parsing, default elision, and copy-on-write
concepts.LX-CORE-NODES: Built-in root, element, text, paragraph, decorator, line-break, tab, and artificial nodes
concepts.LX-CORE-UTIL: Core structural utilities and cleanup composition
concepts.LX-EXTENSION-CONTRACT: Typed extension descriptors, config, dependencies, peers, conflicts, and lifecycle
concepts.LX-EXTENSION-COMPILER: Extension graph compilation, topological order, config merge, build/register, and disposal
concepts.LX-EXTENSION-SIGNALS: Reactive extension signals, watched signal lifecycle, and dependency outputs
concepts.LX-CLIPBOARD: Clipboard MIME import/export, selection serialization, and insertion
concepts.LX-CODE: Code block nodes, flat line structure, tab/indent behavior, and syntax engines
concepts.LX-DEVTOOLS: Editor inspection, state serialization, command log, element picker, and browser extension
concepts.LX-HEADLESS: Headless editor creation and DOM environment adapters
concepts.LX-HISTORY: Undo/redo stacks, merge heuristics, tags, and shared history
concepts.LX-HTML: HTML generation and fitted DOM import
concepts.LX-LINK: Link/autolink nodes, commands, transforms, and extensions
concepts.LX-LIST: List/list-item representation, formatting, checklist, indentation, and normalization
concepts.LX-MARK: Wrapper mark node and range wrapping helpers
concepts.LX-MARKDOWN: Markdown transformers, import, export, and shortcuts
concepts.LX-OFFSET: Flat text-offset view and selection conversion
concepts.LX-REACT: React composers, contexts, plugins, hooks, decorators, and contenteditable host
concepts.LX-RICH-TEXT: Rich-text commands, editing rules, headings, quotes, and extension
concepts.LX-SELECTION-UTIL: Selection geometry, style, slicing, cloning, and traversal helpers
concepts.LX-TABLE: Table nodes, grid selection, observer, navigation, commands, and normalization
concepts.LX-TEXT: Text entity registration, root text subscription, and placeholder policy
concepts.LX-UTILS: Reusable registration, DOM, traversal, merge, and selection utilities
concepts.LX-YJS: Yjs node bindings, relative positions, cursors, snapshots, and bidirectional sync
concepts.LX-SHARED: Cross-package environment, invariant, DOM, diff, and React compatibility helpers
concepts.LX-PLAYGROUND: Playground product nodes, plugins, UI, collaboration, and browser host
concepts.LX-WEBSITE: Documentation site, public concept documentation, and product examples
concepts.LX-PROOF: Unit, integration, browser, regression, fixture, and harness evidence
concepts.LX-PACKAGING: Package metadata, exports, dependency graph, build variants, and workspace boundaries
